QuestInfo.name: Reawakening the Gladius
QuestInfo.1: I showed #p602# #p502#'s #b#t1302009##k, and he revealed that he was the sword's creator. He needs #b1 #t4020109##k, #b1 #t4003004##k, #b1 #t4001007##k, and #b1 #t4001008##k to awaken it. Unfortunately, I've never heard of any of those items... He recommended talking to #b#p513# in #m10004121##k to get started.
QuestInfo.2: I gathered the materials needed for the awakening and took them to #p602#. #p602# used the materials to reawaken the #t1302009# into the #b#t1302014##k. It's a nice sword that radiates a mysterious light... It's a shame I have to give it to #p502#.

0.0: So you want to reawaken this sword. It won't be an easy task, though. Not only will you need to gather up hard-to-find materials, but you'll also need to acquire a rare scroll. But if you still want to go along with it... Then I'll need you to gather up the materials I'm about to tell you. I don't know if you can do it, but...
0.1: Bring me #b1 #t4020109##k, #b1 #t4003004##k, #b1 #t4001007##k, and #b1 #t4001008##k... I'm not sure how you can get these items... but #p513# in #m10004121# might know something...

1.0: My goodness! You actually collected #b1 #t4020109##k, #b1 #t4003004##k, #b1 #t4001007##k, and #b1 #t4001008##k! All right, then.
1.1: Hold on, one second. I haven't done this in ages, but... with these materials, I may be able to pull off the magic and reawaken the #b#t1302009##k.
1.2: Incredible... Tristan's sword... I didn't think I'd live to see this again.

item.0: I may have gone old and gray, but my eyes cannot be deceived. Please gather up #b1 #t4020109##k, #b1 #t4003004##k, #b1 #t4001007##k, and #b1 #t4001008##k, because I don't think you have them all yet.
